name: tuxedo
description: A portable baseline for disciplined, proportional software engineering

interface.longDescription: Classify work by risk, refine only real ambiguity, test behavior fail-first, preserve durable knowledge, review proportionally, and keep authority explicit.
defaultPrompt: Classify this change proportionally and route only the necessary work.
Implement this approved behavior with fail-first tests.
Review this change against its governing input, tests, diff, and fresh results.
